duplicates.decision: Preserve every historical row; latest-per-day deterministic. Historical Tokyo differing-value retention merits human double-check; no cleanup needed to release this candidate.

auditComparison.sourceDifference: audit_table_changes differs only in line formatting; pure helpers prosrc exact but initial fixture omitted live fixed search_path; clean native fixture now explicitly reproduces it.
auditComparison.limitation: Actual hosted audit_logs ancillary full-site trigger chain was inspected read-only, not fully reproduced/executed by isolated pricing/country fixture.

cleanRootCaseFix.status: Implemented and verified locally only; pending production release
cleanRootCaseFix.behavior: Case/outer-space-insensitive root identity lookup; exact persisted names retained in CAS and display. Taichung HSFO scope remains restricted. No automatic business-name normalisation.

redProof.sql: Before fix, allowed TAICHUNG rename caused history GET503/parser rejection and SQL P0002; retained regression failed.
redProof.browser: Actual page red run timed out while history editor stayed disabled; no unrelated external requests.

greenProof.apiSql: 7/7 passed: all six required-root names; save/delete/replay; exact raw-name CAS; stale-name conflict; direct-SQL Taichung product guard; publication reads.
greenProof.actualPage: Both HK and Taiwan real TSX→API→SQL passed with all six roots capitalised/padded, correct product mapping and preserved raw names.
greenProof.native: 14/14 native PostgreSQL17.6 pricing passed with all 12 pricing SQL migrations and live audit helper settings; no skipped tests.
greenProof.adjacent: 30/30 unit/API/SQL market history and required-root tests passed.
greenProof.lint: Focused market helper+Taiwan page eslint passed

blocksResolvedLocally: Permitted required-root capitalisation broke history editor read/save
releaseDependencies: Exact membership-based backup receipt contract must ship with receipt migrations; backup agent owns this change.
Pricing legacy writer fence + all three editor pages + four APIs + helpers + migrations form one coupled cutover.
Final build, full scoped regression, immutable deployment and hosted read-only verification belong to root; none claimed here.
review.noOtherConfirmedBlockers: Independent review completed all original11 SQL and four API implementations. Consistent ports→history→remarks table-lock order, source/content CAS, owned receipt revisions/tombstones and read-only lost-response reconciliation were coherent within inspected scope.
businessSemantics: Normal Save continues existing today-date + same-day history behavior, including metadata edits; not a newly introduced date stamp.
Taiwan history is a whole-day operation over Kaohsiung and Taichung; blank latest fuel means unavailable rather than stale fallback.
Published report date remains effective saved quote day or explicit reviewed override, never forced to current date.
